tokens.name: window
tokens.usage: Window ground: behind the sidebar, between panes, the Settings page. ink 15.2:1 / 15.0:1.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Content panels: lists, the job pane, forms, sheets. ink 16.9:1 / 13.7:1.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, grouped boxes and key caps on surface; the hover row. ink 15.6:1 / 12.4:1; ink-secondary 5.1:1 / 5.6:1.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Behind the resume page and the board: a ground that panels sit on. ink-secondary 4.8:1 / 6.5:1.

tokens.name: glass-nav
tokens.usage: Mockup stand-in for Liquid Glass on navigation only (sidebar, toolbar, menu bar popover). The Mac app uses the system material.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Titles, row titles, body text, on every ground. 16.9:1 light / 13.7:1 dark on surface.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Descriptive text: reasons, evidence, form captions. 10.9:1 / 10.2:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Meta lines, counts, column and group headers, key caps. 5.6:1 / 6.2:1 on surface; at least 4.8:1 / 4.5:1 on surface-raised, window, surface-sunken and accent-tint.

tokens.name: ink-dimmed
tokens.usage: Text of No rows and jobs you've acted on, selected rows included. Dim by colour, never opacity. At least 5.1:1 light / 4.5:1 dark on every ground, accent-tint included.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairlines between panes, sections and the sidebar footer. Decoration only; never the sole cue.

tokens.name: separator-row
tokens.usage: Hairlines between list rows and table rows.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Text-field borders, key-cap borders, switch tracks off: 3.3:1 / 3.5:1 on surface, so a control's edge is always visible.

tokens.name: control-fill
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill (Save, Skip, Open posting). ink on it 14.3:1 / 9.9:1.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one primary button per view and the selected segment. White text 5.7:1 / 5.7:1.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links, plain blue buttons, the selected sidebar icon. 6.1:1 / 7.0:1 on surface; at least 5.5:1 on window and surface-raised.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: The selected row and card. ink 14.7:1 / 10.0:1; ink-secondary 4.8:1 / 4.5:1 on it.

tokens.name: accent-selection-nav
tokens.usage: The selected sidebar item, over the glass.

tokens.name: yes
tokens.usage: Yes verdict text and icon; Shown and Passed marks. 4.7:1 on yes-bg light, 7.1:1 dark; 5.4:1 / 8.4:1 on surface.

tokens.name: yes-bg
tokens.usage: The Yes pill and the menu bar count tile.

tokens.name: yes-solid
tokens.usage: Filled check circle behind a white tick (Shown, Passed, Ready).

tokens.name: maybe
tokens.usage: Maybe verdict text and icon; Partly shown; a stopped run; a follow-up due. 5.5:1 / 7.5:1 on maybe-bg; 6.2:1 / 8.7:1 on surface.

tokens.name: maybe-bg
tokens.usage: The Maybe pill and the count tile.

tokens.name: no
tokens.usage: No verdict text and icon. 5.9:1 / 5.5:1 on no-bg; 7.0:1 / 6.3:1 on surface.

tokens.name: no-bg
tokens.usage: The No pill and the count tile.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Field errors, a board that can't be reached, a failed build. 5.9:1 / 5.8:1 on surface and at least 5.2:1 on surface-raised; never on a selected row. Always with an icon and words.

tokens.name: error-bg
tokens.usage: Behind an error line that needs a ground of its own.

tokens.name: chip-proven-bg
tokens.usage: Proven skill chip, solid fill, ink text.

tokens.name: chip-discuss-border
tokens.usage: Can-discuss skill chip: 1 px dashed border, no fill, ink text.

tokens.name: chip-metric-bg
tokens.usage: Metric chip, radius-chip, with a small chart mark.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: The column title: Inbox, Saved, Resumes. One per column, ink. macOS Large Title.

styles.name: title1
styles.usage: The pane's title: a job's or an application's title. macOS Title.

styles.name: title2
styles.usage: Section headings inside a pane or a form: Must-haves, Timeline, Roles.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Row titles, button labels, form labels.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Reading text: reasons, requirements, the posting.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Meta lines under a title: company, place, posted; evidence under a requirement.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Group headers (Decide, Needs a full read), table column headers, key caps, badges. ink-secondary, letter-spacing 0.2px.

styles.name: score
styles.usage: The match score on a pane. Tabular figures.

styles.name: score-small
styles.usage: The match score in a row. Tabular figures.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Model names, keys shown masked, routes.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label; between a title and its meta line.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between buttons; between rows' contents; chip gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card and key-cap padding; column gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Row side padding; pane section gaps; phone gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Inspector and sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections in a pane or a form.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Pane and page margins: the calm around content.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Compact list row: the default everywhere.

tokens.name: row-height-comfortable
tokens.usage: Rows that carry two lines (tables with a reason line).

tokens.name: sidebar-item-height
tokens.usage: Sidebar item.

tokens.name: toolbar-height
tokens.usage: The system toolbar's height; set by macOS, listed for mockups.

tokens.name: list-width
tokens.usage: The list column's ideal width (320 to 420).

tokens.name: pane-min-width
tokens.usage: The pane never goes narrower.

tokens.name: form-width
tokens.usage: Settings and sheet forms: the reading measure.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum phone target.

tokens.name: phone-row-height
tokens.usage: Phone list row minimum.

tokens.name: radius-keycap
tokens.usage: Key caps.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Metric chips and badges.

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.usage: Text fields, pop-ups, selected rows.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards: verdict card, board cards, status card.

tokens.name: radius-group
tokens.usage: Grouped boxes, tables, sheets.

tokens.name: radius-nav
tokens.usage: The sidebar (18) and the menu bar popover (20).

tokens.name: radius-capsule
tokens.usage: Buttons, segmented controls, verdict pills, skill chips.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Board cards and popovers only. Never on rows or panes.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and the menu bar popover.
